snippet.title: Minigolf Brake! - Official Gameplay Trailer | Switch, Xbox, PlayStation, Steam
snippet.description:
Minigolf Brake! is a playful arcade minigolf game with a healthy dose of ridiculous doodles, weird golf balls, and questionable physics. The twist? You can brake your ball whenever you want. 

The game is coming to Nintendo Switch, Sony PlayStation, Microsoft Xbox and Steam in December 2026.

Check it now!
